public_rationale: On April 1, 2025, JCR changed SoftBank Group’s rating outlook from Stable to Negative while affirming its ratings [e1]. JCR cited planned OpenAI investment of up to $30 billion after syndication, alongside other AI investments, and linked the increasing share of unlisted AI assets to greater equity-value risk [e1]. This supports the claim under the contract’s credit-profile interpretation: OpenAI exposure materially contributed to an adverse outlook action within the April 1–14, 2025 assessment window [e1].
limitations: JCR affirmed the ratings; the adverse action concerned the outlook [e1].
Other AI investments also contributed, and JCR did not quantify OpenAI’s separate contribution [e1].
The evidence does not establish realized investment losses or quantify financial damage [e1].

public_payload.normalized_proposition: SoftBank's exposure to OpenAI is materially harming SoftBank.

statement.excerpt: SoftBank's exposure to OpenAI is materially harming the company.
statement.document_title: OpenAI Is A Systemic Risk To The Tech Industry

our_interpretation: In the surrounding financing and ratings discussion, the plain reading is that OpenAI exposure is already materially weakening SoftBank Group's credit profile or financial flexibility.
An adverse formal credit-outlook action attributable materially to that exposure counts as harm to the credit profile. It does not establish realized investment losses.
The current-state assessment uses the latest pre-publication credit-assessment window, April 1–14, 2025. Later financial outcomes cannot establish this contemporaneous claim.
OpenAI exposure need not be the sole cause, but must be a material identified contributor.
criteria.support_condition: A contemporaneous credit assessment, financing record or financial disclosure documents material deterioration and identifies OpenAI exposure as a material cause.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Contemporaneous evidence establishes that the alleged deterioration did not occur or was attributable to other factors without a material contribution from OpenAI exposure.
